description: Report on the Tidegap task queue. With no arguments, returns a summary of all known tasks (including tasks persisted by previous sessions — the queue survives host restarts). With task_id, returns full detail for one task, including its title, prompt, result and any carbon receipt (estimated vs actual grams, grid_source, energy_source); viewing a completed or failed task marks it read. Never changes a task's status.

task_id.description: If present, return only this task. If omitted, return a queue summary.

name: check_queue_status
